toto_auto_bet_modal_1: Autobet in TOTO will be placed automatically if you have enough money in your account. The Autobet stake is calculated by multiplying the number of bet slips by stake amount per bet slip. TOTO Autobets will continue to be placed until this feature is disabled or until all autobets are placed on the selected number of draws.
toto_auto_bet_modal_10: TOTO "Correct Score", "Football", "Ice Hockey", "Basketball", and "TOTO 15" autobets will be placed 2 hours and 1 minute or more before betting on the current draw stops.
toto_auto_bet_modal_11: There is a rule for all TOTO bets: if you enable this feature 5 minutes before betting on the current draw stops, your bet will not be placed.
toto_auto_bet_modal_12: In the event of unforeseen circumstances, autobets will be placed 5 minutes before betting on a draw stops, provided you have enough money in your account at that time.
toto_auto_bet_modal_2: If you do not have enough funds in your account, the number of remaining draws will not change. An attempt to place a bet will be repeated in the next draw.
toto_auto_bet_modal_3: The number of remaining draws is displayed in the "Autobet" tab on each TOTO page. If your autobet was placed successfully and you have not marked "All" in the Number of Draws section in the settings, the number of remaining draws will go down.
toto_auto_bet_modal_4: Bets are placed at a set time**:

toto_auto_bet_modal_6: autobet on TOTO "Correct Score", "Football", "Ice Hockey", "Basketball", "TOTO 15" will be placed 2 hours before betting on the current draw stops.
toto_auto_bet_modal_7: If you enable this feature before auto-betting on a draw starts, your bet will be placed:

toto_jackpot_rules_list1_1: Player – an individual who has placed a bet as part of the draw in the manner and under the terms stipulated by these Terms and Conditions. The player must be at least 18 years old
toto_jackpot_rules_list1_3: Outcome – one of the potential results of the event on which players place their bets
toto_jackpot_rules_list1_4: Bet Slip – a list of 10 events with their outcomes specified to be filled in by the player in order to place a bet. In the list of outcomes, “1” represents the win of Team 1; “2” represents the win of Team 2; “X” denotes a draw. The player may select more than one outcome for each event; in this case the number of permutations will be higher (and the minimum stake will be increased accordingly)
toto_jackpot_rules_list2_1: 10 correctly predicted outcomes – the player wins the Jackpot worth 90% of the sum total of all bets placed
toto_jackpot_rules_list2_10: The cash equivalent of the undrawn free bets shall be distributed among the players who have predicted all 10 outcomes correctly in proportion to their respective stakes
toto_jackpot_rules_list2_2: 9 correctly predicted outcomes – the player wins a free bet worth 3% of the sum total of all bets placed
toto_jackpot_rules_list2_3: 8 correctly predicted outcomes – the player wins a free bet worth 2% of the sum total of all bets placed
toto_jackpot_rules_list2_4: 7 correctly predicted outcomes – the player wins a free bet worth 1% of the sum total of all bets placed
toto_jackpot_rules_list2_5: 6 or fewer correctly predicted outcomes – the bet slip loses
toto_jackpot_rules_list2_6: The Jackpot and the free bets are distributed among the winning bet slips proportionately to their stakes
toto_jackpot_rules_list2_7: The "sum total of all bets placed" is defined as the total stake of all bets placed by players in the relevant draw
toto_jackpot_rules_list2_8: Free bets must be wagered on sports events and must be placed as accumulator bets containing a minimum of three selections, each at odds of at least 1.50. The free bet remains valid for 30 days after it has been credited to the player’s account. If the total amount of a free bet is less than the minimum stake amount, it shall be credited to the player’s main account directly
toto_jackpot_rules_list2_9: The bookmaker retains 4% of the bets placed as a fee for the organization and conduct of the Jackpot draw
toto_jackpot_rules_list3_1: If an event is considered void, all the outcomes of this event in all bet slips are considered winning
toto_jackpot_rules_list3_2: If 3 or more events in a draw are void, the draw is canceled and the total amount of bets placed shall be refunded to the players (the bookmaker shall not retain 4% for the organization of the Jackpot draw)
toto_jackpot_rules_list3_3: If 2 events in a draw are void, the players that have 7 or 8 correct outcomes shall not be paid
toto_jackpot_rules_list3_4: If one event in a draw is void, the players that have 7 correct outcomes shall not be paid
toto_jackpot_rules_list3_5: The bookmaker shall retain all the funds from unpaid categories
toto_jackpot_rules_list4_1: 9 correct outcomes – the player wins a free bet worth 30% of the sum total of all bets placed
toto_jackpot_rules_list4_10: The bookmaker retains 4% of the bets placed as a fee for the organization and conduct of the Jackpot draw
toto_jackpot_rules_list4_11: The bookmaker shall retain all the funds from unpaid categories
toto_jackpot_rules_list4_2: 8 correct outcomes – the player wins a free bet worth 25% of the sum total of all bets placed
toto_jackpot_rules_list4_3: 7 correct outcomes – the player wins a free bet worth 15% of the sum total of all bets placed
toto_jackpot_rules_list4_4: 6 correct outcomes – the player wins a free bet worth 6% of the sum total of all bets placed
toto_jackpot_rules_list4_5: 2, 3, 4 or 5 correct outcomes - the bet slip loses
toto_jackpot_rules_list4_6: 1 correct outcome - the player receives a consolation prize worth 20% of the total cash value of all bets placed
toto_jackpot_rules_list4_7: The Bad Luck Prize and the free bets are distributed among the winning bet slips in proportion to their respective stakes
toto_jackpot_rules_list4_8: The "sum total of all bets placed" is defined as the total stake of all bets placed by players in the relevant draw
toto_jackpot_rules_list4_9: Free bets must be wagered on sports events and must be placed as accumulator bets containing a minimum of three selections, each at odds of at least 1.50. The free bet remains valid for 30 days after it has been credited to the player’s account. If the total amount of a free bet is less than the minimum stake amount, it shall be credited to the player’s main account directly

toto_jackpot_rules_list6_1: The Jackpot shall be paid out after the winner's passport and bank details have been provided to the administration. The name of the bank account holder must be the same as specified in the passport. The administration undertakes to transfer the winnings to the customer's bank account within no more than 30 calendar days after they have received, checked and issued all the documents required for payout
toto_jackpot_rules_list6_2: The administration shall pay the Jackpot in accordance with the applicable legislation and governing regulations of the relevant country effective at the time of payout
